name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the hard command to pick up the box. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is the hard ban on dropping the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once; the until-wording makes it Precedence even though key_lost already includes the closed-door condition. The door-before-box order is guaranteed by the environment and needs no clause, and no clause is redundant.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room: the mission's target box must be picked up at least once.
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: key_lost must not happen before door_open has happened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
